user.title: Jinan Utilities
user.description: Choose the service and login method. For water (Jinan Water), **Phone only** is recommended: only the registered mobile number is needed. **Mobile + SMS code** also works (no image captcha required). Password login is currently unavailable because the portal image-captcha service is broken. Gas supports SMS or a manually supplied token.

phone.title: Mobile number
phone.description: Enter the mobile number registered with the gas / water online portal. For water this is also the openid used by the API.

captcha.title: Image captcha
captcha.description:
**If the image does not appear, [open it here]({captcha_url})**

![captcha]({captcha_url})

Enter the 4 characters and submit; an SMS code will be sent.

{error}

sms.title: SMS code
sms.description:
Enter the SMS code you received (gas: 5 digits; water needs no image captcha). Tick resend to send again. If water SMS never arrives, use Phone only instead - same result.

{error}

water_captcha.title: Water portal password login
water_captcha.description:
**The Jinan Water image-captcha service is currently broken** (server-side GDI+ initialization failure). Please use Phone only or Mobile + SMS code instead.

**If the image does not appear, [open it here]({captcha_url})**

![captcha]({captcha_url})

{error}

manual.title: Enter access_token manually (fallback)
manual.description:
Water: the portal does not validate the token, so prefer Phone only. Gas: sign in at https://wt.shandongtowngas.com.cn/ , open DevTools Network, copy the token query parameter from any /openapi/uv1/ request.

{error}

error.no_subs: No account found for this number

abort.water_no_bind: No water account bound to this number, or the number is not registered
